visible_input_object: Batch of cells from a donor with donor clinical metadata and gene expression profiles
visible_model_interface: Natural-language contextual metadata prompt built from donor and cell-expression inputs
rationale: The left and middle panels show the grounded inputs (cell batch, donor metadata, gene-expression profiles) and the right-side contextual metadata sentence that serves as the model-visible text carrier. The top-expressed-genes panel is output-like and excluded.
